description: Update notification preferences for the current user — per-type toggles, email frequency, or Do Not Disturb.

emailEnabled.description: Master toggle for all notification emails.

emailFrequency.description: How often to receive email digests.

inAppEnabled.description: Master toggle for all in-app notifications.

preferences.description: Per-type notification toggles, e.g. { "fileEdit": false, "mention": true }.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID. Defaults to configured workspace.

name: update_notification_preferences
